title: Runtime script error inside the new async tests silently yields PASS with exit 0 (false green gate)
evidence:
tests/test_editor_preview.gd:39 	scene._clear_generated()
tests/test_view_purity.gd:38 	var rig: OrbitCamera = main.get_node("OrbitRig")
tests/run_tests.gd:42 		failures += await inst.run_all()
detail: Verified on Godot 4.7.1: a runtime error inside an awaited test coroutine makes run_all return null; `failures += null` absorbs as 0, remaining checks never run, suite prints PASS exit 0. A regression that errors mid-test (renamed helper/node, null instantiate) bypasses the A1 gate silently.
recommended_fix: In run_tests.gd capture `var r = await inst.run_all(); if r == null: failures += 1`; guard the async bodies' derefs (null-scene/get_node/method-exists) so errors convert to counted failures, not silent passes.

title: Sync tests dereference after non-branching checks and index unguarded array tails — regressions abort checks as script errors
evidence:
tests/test_world.gd:79-80 	check(sim is SimCore, "main owns a SimCore (RefCounted — no sim Node in the tree)")
	check(sim.seed_value == SEED, "sim seed = the slice seed")
tests/test_world.gd:104-105 	check(arc != null, "commit returns the pipe arc")
	check(vapprox(arc._a, a.surface_pos, 1e-5), "arc endpoint = node a surface position (sim geometry)")
tests/test_sim_qos.gd:196 	check(int(inflight2[inflight2.size() - 1]) == be_id and inflight2.find(be_id) > inflight2.find(email_id),
detail: check() reports but never branches: on a null sim/arc or empty inflight2, the next line errors, aborting the helper and skipping its remaining checks (suite still exits nonzero, but failure evidence is script-error noise).
recommended_fix: Branch on preconditions: `if not sim is SimCore: return` / `if arc == null: return` after the check, and guard `inflight2.size() > 0` before indexing the tail.
